name: cvstest
install:
npm ci --prefix tools/docs-preview --omit=dev
chmod +x tools/docs-preview/validate-docs.mjs
sudo ln -sfn "$(pwd)/tools/docs-preview/validate-docs.mjs" /usr/local/bin/validate-erp-docs
bash .cursor/install-awscli.sh
start:
if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4173/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERP docs preview already listening on port 4173"
  exit 0
fi
exec node tools/docs-preview/preview-server.mjs
